brief.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: One Japanese basketball news thumbnail, landscape PNG, 1536 x 864 (16:9), minimum width 1000 pixels.
Primary request: Create exactly ONE finished editorial thumbnail for バスケまとめ. Match the viewed approved black-and-lime ink illustration style: near-black #151A18, vivid lime #CCF43B, warm ivory type, bold Japanese typography, energetic dry brush and ink hatching, few elements, clear hierarchy.

Subject and identity: Depict ONLY the real professional basketball player Yoeli Childs (ヨーリ・チャイルズ), whose official Kobe Storks portrait was just inspected in the conversation. Use his actual likeness, never an invented generic player. Facial reference: dense short black curls with closely faded sides, broad oval face and wide strong jaw, full neatly shaped dark beard following the jaw and chin, connected moustache with a small patch under the lower lip, dark almond-shaped eyes, gently arched brows, broad nose with rounded tip, full lips, sturdy neck and muscular broad shoulders. Preserve these distinguishing features. Skin rendered in warm gray/ivory and black brush tones, unmistakably hand-drawn. No photographic texture, no pasted portrait.
Scene: A dynamic imagined basketball movement, not a reconstruction of any actual match. Three-quarter view of Childs on the RIGHT, torso turning left while securing a rebound with BOTH HANDS around ONE orange basketball at upper-chest/shoulder height to his right. Face clearly visible, focused eyes looking toward the ball. Ball and both hands fully inside frame; anatomically natural hands, five digits per hand, two arms only. Show upper thighs to head; natural deliberate crop at thighs. Plain ivory basketball jersey and shorts with dark brush shadows, absolutely no logos, sponsor marks, team name, player name, jersey number or lettering on clothing. No other people.

Layout: LEFT about 58 percent is reserved for typography with generous clear separation from the player. Header small at upper left; two huge headline lines below, the first ivory and the second lime. One compact scope line below headlines. On the right, a diagonal lime brush slash behind the player conveys movement, without clutter or realistic arena. All text and the entire ball stay comfortably within 5 percent safe margins. Footer on a quiet dark area, clearly readable.

Exact text, all and only these seven strings:
「バスケまとめ」
「2026.11.10」
「試合結果」
「当日のEFF」
「B.PREMIER｜ポジション別TOP3」
「イラスト（AI生成）」
「イメージ」

Content constraints: The article is the November 10 game-results and that day's official EFF rankings, by position. The illustrated player was randomly selected from the article's player list; do NOT label him as the star, top performer or any specific rank. Do not show his name, numbers, score, statistics or claims about his participation or achievement. Do not introduce season averages or future predictions. The illustration is only an image of basketball play. Keep the exact date, league scope, daily-EFF wording and position-based TOP3 wording. Do not carry over Culver, Faison, 38 points or any score from the approved style sample. No team/league logos, no official photo pixels, no watermarks besides the required AI label. Create one image only.
